title: Two bookings are created per session
sql: SELECT pg_temp.assert_true((SELECT count(*)=2 FROM resource_bookings WHERE session_id=pg_temp.tid('lesson1')),'two bookings');

title: Overlapping interval is rejected
sql: INSERT INTO lesson_sessions(id,class_id,ordinal,during,state) VALUES(pg_temp.tid('overlap'),pg_temp.tid('class'),20,tstzrange('2030-01-07T11:30Z','2030-01-07T13:00Z','[)'),'SCHEDULED');

title: Adjacent intervals are accepted
sql: INSERT INTO lesson_sessions(id,class_id,ordinal,during,state) VALUES(pg_temp.tid('adjacent'),pg_temp.tid('class'),20,tstzrange('2030-01-07T12:30Z','2030-01-07T14:00Z','[)'),'SCHEDULED'); SELECT pg_temp.assert_true((SELECT count(*)=2 FROM resource_bookings WHERE session_id=pg_temp.tid('adjacent')),'adjacent');

title: Cancellation deactivates both bookings
sql: UPDATE lesson_sessions SET state='CANCELLED' WHERE id=pg_temp.tid('lesson1'); SELECT pg_temp.assert_true(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resource_bookings WHERE session_id=pg_temp.tid('lesson1') AND active),'cancelled');

title: Twenty active source versions are accepted
